content: Shimaoka et al. shimaoka2016attentive proposed an attentive neural network model which used long short-term memory (LSTMs) to encode the context of the entity, then used an attention mechanism to allow the model to focus on relevant expressions in the entity mention's context. To learn entity representations, we propose a scheme which is potentially more generalizable.
